jobs.prompt: Cinematic noir photograph of a small investigator's office late in the evening, close to night, autumn 2009, wider view from slightly behind and above the empty chair, nobody in the room. The office lights are off. The only light comes from a retro green glass banker's desk lamp on the desk, giving a soft warm pool of light, and from two warm lamps mounted above a large cork board on the wall behind the desk. The board is well lit and clearly visible: papers, notes and photographs of places and objects pinned in loose rows, no faces, no string. At the edge of the light a trench coat hangs on a wooden coat rack, half in shadow. Everything to the left and right falls off into deep darkness; no side walls are visible. On the worn wooden desk: case papers and manila folders, a clear plastic evidence bag with a card tag, a black flat LCD monitor of 2009 with a thick bezel, switched off, a black office desk phone with many buttons, plastic trays, and on the free right corner a short glass with a little whisky. Everything inside the pools of light is easy to see. Deep shadows, strong contrast, warm amber light with the green glow of the lamp shade, slight film grain. No people, no ceiling lights, no windows, no blinds, no hat, no typewriter, no smoke, no ashtray, no CRT monitor, no readable text, no logos.
